cards.name: Koby
cards.text: [Opponent's Turn] If your Leader has the "Navy" type, this Character gains +1000 power.[When Attacking] K.O. up to 1 of your opponent's Characters with 3000 base power or less. Then, if you have 6 or less cards in your hand, draw 1 card.

cards.name: Trafalgar Law - PRB02-002
families: Heart Pirates The Seven Warlords of the Sea Punk Hazard
cards.text: [Once Per Turn] If this Character would be removed from the field by your opponent's effect, you may give this Character -2000 power during this turn instead.[When Attacking] Give up to 1 of your opponent's Characters -2000 power during this turn.

cards.name: Lucky.Roux
cards.text: [Blocker] (After your opponent declares an attack, you may rest this card to make it the new target of the attack.)[On Play] You may trash 1 Character card with 6000 power or more from your hand: Draw 2 cards.

cards.name: Jewelry Bonney -PRB02-004
cards.text: [Blocker] (After your opponent declares an attack, you may rest this card to make it the new target of the attack.)[On Your Opponent's Attack] [Once Per Turn] Set up to 1 of your DON!! cards as active.

cards.name: Monkey.D.Luffy - PRB02-005
cards.text: [Your Turn] [On Play] If your Leader is multicolored and your opponent has 7 or less DON!! cards on their field, your opponent rests 1 of their active DON!! cards at the start of their next Main Phase.

cards.name: Roronoa Zoro - PRB02-006
cards.text: [Opponent's Turn] If this Character would be rested by your opponent's Character's effect, you may rest 1 of your other Characters instead.[Blocker]

cards.name: Jinbe - PRB02-007
families: Fish-Man The Seven Warlords of the Sea The Sun Pirates
cards.text: [On Play] Look at 5 cards from the top of your deck; reveal up to 1 "The Seven Warlords of the Sea" type card other than [Jinbe] and add it to your hand. Then, place the rest at the bottom of your deck in any order.

cards.name: Marco
families: Former Whitebeard Pirates Land of Wano
cards.text: [Blocker](After your opponent declares an attack, you may rest this card to make it the new target of the attack.)[On K.O.] Draw 2 cards.

cards.name: Mr.3(Galdino) - PRB02-009
cards.text: This effect can be activated when this Character is rested by your opponent's effect. You may trash this Character and draw 2 cards.[Blocker]

cards.name: Charlotte Pudding - PRB02-010
cards.text: [On Play] DON!! -2: If your Leader has the "Big Mom Pirates" type and your opponent has 6 or more DON!! cards on their field, draw 2 cards. Then, play up to 1 "Big Mom Pirates" type Character card with 6000 to 8000 power from your hand.

cards.name: Donquixote Doflamingo
families: Donquixote Pirates The Seven Warlords of the Sea
cards.text: [Blocker][On Play] If your Leader is multicolored, add up to 1 DON!! card from your DON!! deck and rest it.

cards.name: Nami
cards.text: [On Play] Look at 5 cards from the top of your deck; reveal up to 1 "Straw Hat Crew" type card other than [Nami] and add it to your hand. Then, place the rest at the bottom of your deck in any order.[Trigger] Play this card.

cards.name: Gecko Moria
families: The Seven Warlords of the Sea Thriller Bark Pirates
cards.text: [On Play] If your Leader has the "Thriller Bark Pirates" type, play up to 1 Character card with a cost of 4 or less from your trash rested. Then, give up to 1 rested DON!! card to your Leader or 1 of your Characters.

cards.name: Sabo - PRB02-014
cards.text: If you have 15 or more cards in your trash, give this card in your hand -3 cost.[Blocker] (After your opponent declares an attack, you may rest this card to make it the new target of the attack.)

cards.name: Otama
cards.text: [Activate: Main] You may rest this Character and add 1 card from the top or bottom of your Life cards to your hand: Up to 1 of your Leader or Character cards gains +3000 power during this turn.[Trigger] Rest up to 1 of your opponent's Characters with a cost of 4 or less.

cards.name: Boa Hancock
families: FILM Kuja Pirates The Seven Warlords of the Sea
cards.text: [Once Per Turn] You may trash 1 card with a [Trigger] from your hand: Your opponent's rested Leader or up to 1 of your opponent's Characters other than [Monkey.D.Luffy] cannot attack until the end of your opponent's next End Phase.[Trigger] K.O up to 1 of your opponent's Characters with a cost of 4 or less

cards.name: Portgas.D.Ace - PRB02-018
cards.text: [On Play] If you have a face-up Life card, play up to 1 [Sabo], [Portgas.D.Ace], or [Monkey.D.Luffy] with a cost of 2 from your hand or trash.
